notes.title: Next Fest Results and Release Date Change
notes.content:
[p]Good Meowning all,[/p][p][/p][p]Wanted to share the results of the Next Fest and thank everyone who gave the game a try and wishlisted it! The results are probably better than I expected as I had stopped doing any marketing since I released the demo.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537008/0b24dce72d77e66913fae4415dab2168eb535820.png"][/img][/p][p] In fact once I released the demo it was quite a weight off my shoulders as I had got something essentially close to complete out. The original plan was to just release it without the wave cap and with some more polish because to develop me I really needed proper game feedback but never really got much.[/p][p][/p][p]After some deep thought though I have decided I will push back the release date and flesh the game out more as I believe it still has potential but it's lacking in polish. The game was to release with exactly the features described on the main page but here is what you can expect from this pushed back release:[/p][list][*][p]an actual tutorial that takes you through the basics[/p][/*][*][p]a basic but thought out story about a cat on his adventures around the universe.[/p][/*][*][p]at least 2 minigames[/p][/*][*][p]more modes that you'd typically see in an idle games such as boss rushes, towers, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]revamped skill system as currently one is quite janky.[/p][/*][*][p]in game shop (not real currency) where you can buy specific unique items to help curve RNG.[/p][/*][*][p]More unique items! there were only 3 in the demo.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Also a reminder there are no plans to add P2W in this game or MTX and there still never will be. I was trying to create a game that mimics an idle game without the P2W. 

Hopefully that has not disappointed anyone. Enjoy the summer! I will see you again in the fall.[/p]

notes.title: Demo is ready!
notes.content:
[h3]Demo is out![/h3]

Meowdy there!

After many iterations and polish [b]Mister Gato Idle - The Meowsiah[/b] demo is ready to play!

I hope you enjoy playing it. I welcome any feedback about the game and any features you would like to see. This is a solid base and the game can really expand.

[h2]Features:[/h2]
- Play up to zone 25, you can continue to play after beating zone 25.
- All planned features are here.
- Play the minigame Banjo Hero which is similar to other rhythm games. Claim rewards based on your high score.
- No P2W, no MTX, no red dots, etc. It's not a mobile game despite the way it looks.
- Offline rewards with no cap based on a KPM system.
- Loot system with rarities and 3 different Unique items.
- Random skill generator instead of set skills. No skill trees!
- upgrade your base skill with an orb system, customise it how you like.
- Super Banjo Mode if you want to play actively.
- Manual save and load and a emergency backup save method. Game needs STEAM cloud.

[h1]Known Bugs[/h1]
- at some point you might lose all of your skills. At the moment skills are a little underpowered so losing these is not that bad but it does happen and it's something I'm looking at



Read the Meowpedia if you want more information in game:

notes.title: New Capsule Art and more!
notes.content:
[h1]New capsule Art![/h1]

Meodwy invisible friends!

Today I present some new capsule art to replace the old one. Here we feature an updated Meowsiah, higher quality backdrop and I've placed most of the regular enemy cats onto the platform for one of the capsules and left the others ones without enemies. Let me know if it's any good!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537008/abc60ae80f4c66dedca5bd9812eb56b209281de5.png[/img]


[h1]Minigames![/h1]

There are 2 mini games at the moment that are just about finished for a Demo. For both games the score is converted into [b]coins [/b]and [b]crystals [/b]in the [b]main game.[/b]

This is [b]Flappy Cat[/b] where you have to get through gaps within the walls and pick up crystals. The walls moves both up and down and you can bounce off the top of the walls. Crystals spawn that give a bonus score, the higher the crystal on the level the more it awards but the higher the risk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537008/a2cfbcce24b687c4f12ba325308d48cd5c712116.png[/img]


Next we have [b]Banjo Hero[/b]. There is a banjo song that plays and you have to match the notes by pressing the right key on the keyboard. You get more points for a perfect strike and lose points for missing. It's fairly simple in it's implementation but it's fun and expandable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537008/cba12a6b60b3b314ea7ff499bc918cc7de268073.png[/img]

notes.title: Offline Loot mechanic using Steam Time and KPM
notes.content:
[h3]Offline Loot mechanic[/h3]

Mister Gato Idle features an offline loot mechanic. When your offline your awarded coin and crystals depending on your KPM (kills per minute).

This is how it works:
[list]
[*] the game calculates a KPM (kills per minute). This calculation takes 1 min to calculate and freezes during a boss.
[*] when you quit the game your exit time is noted in the Steam Cloud (using Steam time) along with the KPM.
[*] if your KPM is 0, it will default to 20.
[*] when the game loads it will use the current Steam Time and compare it to your saved time to work out how long you were offline for.
[*] You are then awarded an appropriate amount of coin and crystal dependant on the wave you were at
[*] This means you can be offline and still get critical rewards. You don't get any orbs from doing this though.
[*] This means you should use gear that maximises your KPM and make sure it is recorded before you quit the game to get the maximum benefit.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537008/49e2f9adb8cf905c788f8a840dcc2101271de879.png[/img]

notes.title: Minigames!
notes.content:
[b]Good Meowning![h2][/h2][/b]

I'm working on minigames to play inside the idle game. The idea is you can find a rare arcade token or it will be time limited and you can play a variety of skill based arcade games. Your score gets converted into coins/crystals so the better you do the more rewards you get.

So far I have 2 working prototypes that need some polish.

This is a prototype for "Flappy Bird" style game. The walls fall from the top and there is a gap for the player to jump through. The walls gets faster as the game goes on. Instead of dying when you hit the bottom, you can remain at the bottom but crystals spawn at different heights which are worth a lot of points forcing you to decide to move to collect them or not:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537008/4fb71dfc9b86c67e813012bb491db79baaf346d9.png[/img]


Next is quite exciting, it's a rhythm game using one of the ingame songs. The notes fall and you press the right key awarding more points for perfect timing, etc. I'm aiming this one to be a little bit more like New World's rhythm game in complexity so there won't be any fancy holds/star power etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537008/0b50c686d84b7122da982cfe46ce7b55e9335713.png[/img]

There are a lot more minigames I could make. If you've any ideas let me know!
